g1_1_business.what_it_does: Granules India Limited is a pharmaceutical company that specializes in the production of generic drugs. The company operates across various segments including Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), Pharmaceutical Formulations Intermediates (PFI), and Finished Dosages (FD). It is recognized as the fourth-largest player in the US controlled-substance market and has been transitioning towards complex generics and peptide Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.

customers.description: Companies that require generic drugs and active pharmaceutical ingredients.
Providers that utilize finished dosages in patient care.

manufacturing.description: Facility for producing finished dosages with a capacity increase of ~40%.
Site undergoing remediation with 9 launches waiting for FDA clearance.

competitive_advantage: Backward integration from API to FD, creating a strong supply chain.
Regulatory barriers in the controlled substances market provide a competitive edge.
Established reputation with a 40-year quality record and zero critical observations in audits.
Diverse product portfolio with a focus on complex generics and peptides.
Strong promoter backing and institutional interest.

drivers.title: Genome Valley Capacity Increase
drivers.why_it_matters: This capacity increase allows Granules to meet growing demand and expand its market share in the complex generics segment.

drivers.title: Peptide CDMO Target
drivers.fact: Peptide CDMO FY27 target = PAT-positive annual / $50 Mn @ 30%+ EBITDA by mid-FY29.
drivers.why_it_matters: Achieving this target will significantly enhance profitability and diversify revenue streams.
